description: Search the New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978 BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation, e.g. "landlord security deposit", "concealed handgun", "grounds for divorce". Matches official section CATCHLINES (and chapter names), not full statutory body text. Returns matching citations, catchlines, and chapter names; call nm_statute with a result's citation for the full text. Keyless.

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 25.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "landlord security deposit".

name: nm_search
title: Nm Search
